text:
Kate: Quick sync — proposing 'slimline' onboarding lanes to speed model acceptance for smaller customers. TL;DR: two lanes (fast-track & standard). Fast-track = lighter benchmarks, 3-day review, no pin by default. Thoughts?

Omar: +1 to lanes. what's the acceptance gate for fast-track?

Kate: propose basic checks: functional smoke tests, perf profile (p95 < 250ms for 512 tokens), mem < 12GB, basic safety scan. If pass, can bypass long-run evals.

Linh: That p95 seems high for hosted; can we set for dedicated different thresholds?

Priya: yes make thresholds per deployment. Fast-track for hosted only. Dedicated/private require full eval and pin review.

Ben: ops question — how do we handle pin TTLs and migration notices? customers hate surprise swaps.

Kate: Suggest soft-pin model for 30 days then auto-deprecate unless customer opts-in. Send 60-day migration notice earlier.

Omar: Could we offer 'grace-credits' for migration to newer model? sales would like that.

Priya: agree — 3 months free preferred/discounted capacity during migration window. Add to product policy doc.

Kate: For benchmarks, propose three buckets: smoke (FF), regressions (A/B), and scale perf (burst/steady). Minimum artifact: deterministic prompt set + golden outputs.

Linh: We need tooling to run golden set across model variants. can we add a runbook?

Ben: ops-bot: created runbook template #runbooks/catalog-onboard-1719991234

Kate: sample config snippet for gate check:

```
gate:
  p95_latency_ms: 250
  mem_gb_max: 12
  safety_block: false
```

Omar: minimal but fine. Next: launch criteria — require rollout plan + rollback triggers + canary at 5% for 48h.

Priya: add customer opt-in checkbox for pin exceptions in contract.

Linh: Can we split onboard work into two sprints? sprint1: tooling & fast-track; sprint2: dedicated gating + migration incentives.

Kate: timeline: sprint1 end = 2 weeks, sprint2 end = 6 weeks. anyone blocking?

Ben: infra needs an ETA on KV cache changes; will update by EOD.

Omar: I'll draft the product PRD and include sample comms for customers.

Kate: thanks all. I'll put final lanes doc in Figma + link in docs.

Priya: :thumbsup:

Linh: leaving a note — avoid auto-deprecate for critical pinned models unless legal sign-off.

Kate: noted. will add explicit exemption flow.

Omar: assigning follow-ups: @Omar PRD, @Linh runbooks, @Ben infra ETA, @Priya customer incentives.

Kate: closing — thanks.
